parameters.help_en:
The audience source.
0: Text. Each line contains one phone number. A maximum of 100 phone numbers is allowed.
1: Text file. Each line contains one phone number. You can upload the file in the console or specify a custom OSS URI. Before specifying a custom OSS URI, you must complete one-click authorization in the console.
2: CSV file. You must specify the column name for phone numbers. You can upload the file in the console or specify a custom OSS URI. Before specifying a custom OSS URI, you must complete one-click authorization in the console.
3: MaxCompute (ODPS) table. You must specify the column name for phone numbers.
4: Algorithm
parameters.help_zh:
人群来源。
0: 文本，每行一个手机号，最多100个。
1: 文本文件，每行一个手机号，可通过控制台上传或指定自定义OSS地址，指定自定义OSS地址前需确保已在控制台完成一键授权。
2: CSV文件，需指定手机号列名，可通过控制台上传或指定自定义OSS地址，指定自定义OSS地址前需确保已在控制台完成一键授权。
3: MaxCompute(ODPS)表，需指定手机号列名。
4: 算法
